title: Velvety Dutch Smoked Turkey Neck Stew
description: A rich and savory stew featuring smoked turkey neck, dashi extract, and a blend of spices, all cooked to perfection in a banana leaf vessel. This dish is low in sodium and perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the smoked turkey neck, dashi extract, low-sodium chicken broth, black pepper, and salt-free seasoning blend to the pot.
Stir to combine, then bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the pot, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Braise the stew for 2 hours, or until the meat is tender and falling off the bone.
Remove the pot from the oven, and let it cool slightly.
Spoon the stew into the center of a banana leaf, and fold the leaf to form a packet.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
